calls.thesis: BUY first tracked. McCormick (spices): down ~30% YTD, weighed down by the planned combination with Unilever's food business; low beta (<1), dividend aristocrat with 38 consecutive years of increases. Undervalued vs the S&P 500 (~20x) and vs its own history — a stock that pays you to wait.
calls.base_case: Unilever food deal closes and adds to EPS; dividend keeps compounding.
calls.bull_case: Deal goes well and adds significantly to earnings per share; stock re-rates from ~9x PE.
calls.bear_case: Deal fails or drags and the stock stays cheap for a while.
